description: This file defines the DepthFirstGraphNodeIterator class for traversing nodes in a Torch JIT graph using depth-first search.

classes.name: DepthFirstGraphNodeIterator
classes.description: A class facilitating depth-first iteration over all nodes in a Torch JIT graph.

methods.name: move_up
methods.description: Moves the iterator up the graph hierarchy, handling different node types and block ownership.

methods.name: move_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next node in the current block or moves up if at the end.

methods.name: move_into
methods.description: Enters into sub-nodes of control flow nodes like if, loop, or with blocks.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the current node and advances the iterator.
